doc.summary: lazy_llamacpp_setup.sh — one-time local LLM setup for LazyOwn users.
doc.description: Interactively (or via flags) it: 1. builds llama.cpp from the lazy_llamacpp addon clone (CUDA when present), 2. downloads the Qwen 27B GGUF model (~8GB, asks first), 3. starts the server through lazy_llamacpp_serve.sh, 4. optionally patches opencode (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json), 5. optionally patches hermes (~/.hermes/config.yaml), 6. optionally sets payload.json local_llm so fast_run uses it.  Flags (all default to asking): --yes            accept every default without prompting --no-download    skip the model download (reuse existing models/*.gguf) --no-opencode    skip opencode config patch --no-hermes      skip hermes config patch --no-payload     skip payload.json local_llm change  The operator's existing setup is never touched without an explicit yes.
